trace_hash_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 compact JSON list of Packet dataclass dictionaries, trace order.
pairing: Generate once per seed/load, then reuse identical packets for all three policies.
summary_method: Unweighted mean and sample standard deviation across seeds; n=1 SD is 0 by convention. Per-run p95 delays are averaged, not pooled into a common percentile. These SDs are descriptive, not confidence intervals or significance tests.
paired_method: candidate minus baseline, first calculated within each seed/load; positive on_time_success_pct_delta means improvement in percentage points. Negative mean_delay_ms_delta means lower delivered-packet delay.
model: One nonpreemptive link; finite waiting queue with tail drop; arrivals stop then admitted packets drain.
observation: Each run uses 0 to max(arrival horizon, last completion).
metric_note: On-time success divides by all generated packets including tail drops as failures. Delay statistics describe delivered packets. All classes have synthetic deadlines.
provenance: Artificial traffic generated in Python. No clinical targets, hospital measurements, or patient data. The experiment does not establish hospital performance or safety.
